name: Moon-Touched Sword

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: In darkness, the unsheathed blade sheds moonlight (bright 15 ft, dim 15 ft more).
text: Drawn in the dark, this sword's blade glows with moonlight: Bright Light out to 15 feet and Dim Light 15 feet beyond that.
